action.objective: Verify c1e3 at full depth using the reserved verification allowance, then commit the strongest verified developing move.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested c1e3 (score 4) with Be3 development, but it is only depth 2 and not yet commit-ready. Reserved verification allows a single-candidate depth-4 search of c1e3 with 2000 nodes. c1e3 develops the dark-square bishop, fits the prior plan (Be3 after d2d3), and the broad search already favored it. Verifying before committing is required since commit_ready_moves is empty.
